rows.grounds: Locative of the compound kula-pūjā, indicating the context of clan worship.
Fused sandhi form of asya (of this) and āvaśyakatva (necessity), expressing indispensability.

items.question: What necessity attaches to this practice within the context of kula-worship?
premises: Kula-worship is the ritual context under discussion.
A specific practice within it is being evaluated.
That practice is declared to possess necessity.
items.inference: Therefore, this practice is indispensable within kula-worship.
uncertainties: The referent of asya depends on the immediately preceding alternatives in verses 3773–3774.
items.plain_english: In kula-worship, this is absolutely necessary.
